title: Add Email/query FilterCondition and Filter types (RFC 8621 §4.4)
description: jmap-mail-server cannot implement Email/query without filter types. Need: FilterCondition struct (all RFC 8621 §4.4 fields), FilterOperator enum (AND/OR/NOT with conditions array), and a Filter enum that is either FilterCondition or FilterOperator (the wire format uses a discriminated union keyed on the presence of the 'operator' field).
design: Filter is a serde untagged enum: Filter::Condition(FilterCondition) vs Filter::Operator(FilterOperator). RFC 8621 §4.4 distinguishes them by presence of 'operator' key. FilterCondition fields: inMailbox (Id), inMailboxOtherThan (Vec<Id>), before/after (UTCDate), minSize/maxSize (u64), allInThreadHaveKeyword/someInThreadHaveKeyword/noneInThreadHaveKeyword (String), hasKeyword/notKeyword (String), hasAttachment (bool), text/from/to/cc/bcc/subject/body (String), header (Vec<String> 1-2 elements). All fields are Option. FilterOperator fields: operator (FilterOperatorKind), conditions (Vec<Filter>).
